title: Deselecting every technician hides the chart
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. A technician chart expanded (View details on Technician Efficiency).
custom_steps: 1. On a technician chart, deselect every technician and confirm the chart is hidden rather than shown empty (until at least one technician is selected again).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the user deselects every technician on a technician chart, the chart is hidden rather than shown empty.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9580 (S8 — Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S8; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N1: “If the user deselects every technician on a technician chart, that chart is hidden rather than shown empty.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
